About Aist
establishment
Adina Institute of Science & Technology was established in 2009, with the vision of providing quality education in the fields of technology and engineering. Our Institute emerged in response to the growing demand for technically skilled professionals in a rapidly developing country like India. Our aim is to bridge the gap between academic education and industry requirements.
Academic Programs
Our institute offers diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various engineering streams such as Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Civil Engineering. Our institute also offers programs in emerging areas like Artificial Intelligence
Infrastructure and Facilities
Adina Institute of Science & Technology prioritizes to provide state-of-the-art infrastructure. This includes well-equipped laboratories, computer centres, libraries with a vast collection of resources, and residential facilities for students and staff. The campus is designed to foster a conducive learning environment, with spaces for innovation and collaboration.
Research and Collaboration
Research is a critical component at Adina Institute of Science &Technology. In our pursuit of academic excellence, we have established research labs and collaborative programs with industry partners. These collaborations can provide students with practical exposure and opportunities to work on real-world problems.
Contribution to Society and Industry
Our Institute plays a crucial role in contributing to the local and national economy by producing skilled professionals. We have initiatives for community development, skill enhancement, and entrepreneurship, fostering an ecosystem that supports innovation and practical problem-solving.
Alumni and Network
Over the years since our inception, Adina Institute of Science & Technology has built an alumni network. The success stories of our alumni can be a testament to the quality of education and opportunities the institute provides.
Challenges and Opportunities
As with any educational institution, Adina Institute of Science & Technology faces its unique set of challenges and opportunities. Adapting to the rapidly changing technological landscape, ensuring the employability of graduates, and maintaining high educational standards are some of the challenges. Opportunities lies in expanding its reach, developing specialized programs, and increasing international collaborations.
Conclusion
Adina Institute of Science & Technology, since its establishment in 2009, has grown and evolved, adapting to the educational needs of the time while contributing to the field of technology and engineering education in India.

Adina Group of Institutions is a prestigious group of educational institutions located in Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, India. The group was established by Shri P. C. Adina College of Pharmacy was established in 2019 at the same campus in Sagar. The institutes have a successful background in the field of education and are committed to providing quality education to students.
The institutes are dedicated to providing a holistic education to students, making them responsible citizens. The objective of the institutes is to train students to become world-class technocrats while nurturing their personalities by providing them full support for their all-round development. The institutes possess a dedicated team of faculties coming from the best institutes of the country who not only impart knowledge to the students but also act as their mentors. The infrastructure and facilities have been carefully developed so as to transmit professionalism to the students.
